title: The next bound comes from the overrun
hook: The failed frontier tells the next search where to begin.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Search trees; minimax and a partial solution state.
doesNotKnow: Increase IDA* thresholds to the smallest exceeded g+h value rather than arbitrary increments.

misconception: Every unsuccessful bounded search should just add one to its threshold.
objective: Increase IDA* thresholds to the smallest exceeded g+h value rather than arbitrary increments.

claims.text: A failed pass remembers the smallest f=g+h that exceeded its threshold. That value becomes the next threshold, so the search does not skip the next promising frontier. The final route is found within its cost bound.
